key_risks.description: The company faces uncertainties and risks related to various economic, political, and regulatory environments, particularly in developing and emerging markets.

The fair value of the BodyArmor trademark was less than its carrying value, leading to an impairment charge of $960 million. Further impairment may occur if near-term operating results do not meet revised projections or if macroeconomic conditions worsen.
